resources.string: Remembers where you left the bike when you disconnect from the dash. Shown on the main screen, the home-screen widget and the watch, with walking directions.
When you connect, checks the forecast for the next 3 hours around you (Open-Meteo, approximate location only) and warns you on the phone and the watch if rain is likely.
Android Auto navigation buzzes your watch before each manoeuvre: 2 pulses left, 3 right, long + N short for roundabout exit N, two long for a U-turn. Experimental.
Applies from the next connection to the dash.
